hintNote.message: Click anywhere in the panel to give it focus — that's what turns the hotkeys on

deckEmptyHintB.message: Open a YouTube tab with a track to start mixing

hintLeftRightDesc.message: left key lowers, right key raises — same order for every knob pair above

hintBothAgainDesc.message: cuts to minimum, once already at neutral

hintTabDesc.message: swap which track is A / B (or the big header button, once connected)

hintAlwaysOnDesc.message: shared between decks, not a per-deck setting

hintTempoArrowsDesc.message: or drag the bar between the BPM readouts — blends tempo and automatically re-aligns beat phase too, no separate sync action needed
